name: dsh-mac-tools
description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: a local macOS toolbox panel — QQ-style screenshot capture with crop and annotations, a calculator, phone transfer (QR-code LAN page for text/files/images), clipboard, and a 运行状态 / Status dashboard (CPU, memory, disk, network, battery, system information, SMC temperatures and fans, process ranking, threshold alerts) with Macs Fan Control style fan-speed control
author: long0521
